recognize_zh: 組合圖：流式顯示 CD38+/CD138+、胞質 kappa 限制、CD20+/CD19− 的漿細胞；H&E 為成片小型、核略偏心的成熟樣漿細胞；IHC 顯示 CD138 膜染、BCL1（cyclin D1）核染與 CD20 膜染皆強陽性，符合小細胞型多發性骨髓瘤而非被 CD20/BCL1 誤導的 MCL。
features: Flow (A): CD38/CD138 double-positive plasma cells, cytoplasmic kappa restricted, CD20 positive and CD19 negative
H&E (B): diffuse sheets of small, monotonous cells with round, slightly eccentric nuclei and scant cytoplasm replacing marrow
CD138 IHC (C): strong membranous staining of nearly all cells
BCL1/cyclin D1 IHC (D): strong nuclear staining in the majority of cells
CD20 IHC (E): strong membranous staining in the neoplastic cells
Small lymphocyte-like size of the plasma cells mimics a B-cell lymphoma
describe_en: This composite figure combines flow cytometry and bone marrow biopsy stains. Flow cytometry (A) identifies a plasma cell population that is CD38 and CD138 positive, cytoplasmic kappa restricted, CD20 positive and CD19 negative. The H&E-stained biopsy (B) shows diffuse sheets of small, monotonous cells with round, slightly eccentric nuclei that largely replace the marrow. Immunohistochemistry shows strong membranous CD138 (C), strong nuclear cyclin D1/BCL1 (D) and strong membranous CD20 (E) in the neoplastic cells. Together with an IgG M-spike and absence of t(11;14) on karyotype, findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma, small-cell (lymphoplasmacytoid) subtype, with aberrant CD20 and cyclin D1 co-expression rather than mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Cells are CD19, PAX5 and CD5 positive and CD138 negative with surface light chain, and SOX11 positivity and t(11;14) by FISH are typical.
Shows a spectrum of CD19+ lymphocytes with a separate plasma cell component, an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Contains CD19/PAX5-positive B cells alongside plasma cells and lacks cyclin D1.
Also often small/lymphoplasmacytoid, CD20+ and cyclin D1+; FISH is more sensitive than karyotype, so t(11;14) should still be excluded by FISH.

stain: H&E; IHC: CD138, BCL1, CD20; flow
